title: Beautifully Restored Guesthouse, 564
description:
The Retreats at South Water Manor are a one of kind destination. Originally built in the 1860s, this building was used as servants quarters, while the second was a summer kitchen for the FitzGerald Manor, which remains on the property. Essentially untouched for the past 100 years, they underwent a complete, exhaustive renovation from the ground up, converting them into the upscale guesthouses they are today. Luxurious finishes and high attention to detail make them an experience to remember.

Guest access
You have access to your rented building (#564) as well as the outdoor pergola area. Bistro 562 & Coffee House, which is inside of South Water Manor (just steps away) is open for breakfast and lunch, Tuesday-Saturday!
